keyFindings.description: The district layout contains a potential navigation issue. The route path does not follow the water bodies or roads consistently, which might confuse players.
keyFindings.suggestion: Ensure that the route follows the road and water features more logically.

keyFindings.description: The route path includes some cells that do not seem to be roads or part of a navigable path. This could lead to player frustration.
keyFindings.suggestion: Verify all cells in the route are valid and accessible.
